payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_finish.py::test_each_finding_names_the_head_the_end_review_graded_its_layer_at stayed green with the spec's wrong version 'Only the `spec` and `standards` lenses take the graded head, so a join entry keeps the `pushed_sha`.' applied to saffron/finish.py as an edit. The claim was "`finish.write_findings` takes the same `heads`. For a layer named there, each `qualifications` entry from an end-review lens or the join carries that head as its `head`. The witness drives the `spec`, `standards` and `join` lenses, as pooled, `follow_up` and `unanchored` entries. Each `qualifications` entry from a lens in `review.LENSES` keeps the layer's `pushed_sha`, and the witness drives all four of those lenses. A layer `heads` lacks keeps its `pushed_sha` on every entry, its critic entries included. A follow-up that added no layer keeps the head it names without `heads`. The witness names one generation-0 layer and leaves the bottom layer and the generation-1 layer out.", and only that witness ran under the edit.
